findings.F1_roleDefinitionsAbsent: 12/12 ZIPs contain zero link:roleType elements. Presentation roles are http://dart.fss.or.kr/role/ifrs/dart_2013-03-31_role-D<code> and the instance's roleRefs point to external DART taxonomy files (rol_dart_2013-03-31.xsd). No role definition text is in any ZIP, so statement_kind() never receives a definition. Role-to-statement mapping needs an external resource.
findings.F2_conceptHrefsExternal: Standard IFRS concept locs use absolute URLs on http://dart.fss.or.kr/Resource/Taxonomy/ifrs/2013-03-31/ifrs-cor_2010-04-30.xsd#ifrs_<Element>. Those resources are not in the ZIP, and the reader admits only xbrl.ifrs.org / xbrl.iasb.org hosts. Fragments do equal ifrs_<Element>.
findings.F3_balanceSheetConceptsAbsent: For all 6 Assets/Liabilities facts, the element has no loc in any presentation network in the ZIP (the only presentation linkbase is the dimensions one). Presentation cannot prove balance-sheet membership from the ZIP even with a perfect reader.
findings.F4_partialForOthers: Operating cash flow: locs found in role D520005 (and D520000 when present), connected by live arcs, for 3/3 (the role's meaning is itself not defined in the ZIP). ProfitLoss: 0 locs in 1/3; in the other 2 the locs sit in roles whose statement cannot be established from the ZIP and most are not connected by live arcs.
findings.F5_identityEvidence: 12/12: unique instance pointer, entity == frozen corpCode, unitRef and decimals as frozen, raw text equals the candidate amount (descriptive), ZIP SHA equals the frozen v1 zipSha256.
